# mzcache REFERENCE device profile — Galaxy S25+ (SM-S936N, Adreno 830).
# This is the exact profile the paper's Figure-14 accuracy (F1) numbers were
# produced with. The profile decides the lossy-compress vs lossless-store chunk
# split at swap-out (decomp_load_ratio = decomp/(decomp+kv_read)), so F1 itself
# depends on it. scripts/compression/accuracy/roundtrip_phone.sh pins this file on the device
# for the duration of the accuracy roundtrip and restores the experimenter's own
# profile afterwards. Do not edit — see docs/reproduce_f1_accuracy.md.
version=1
compression=FLEXGEN_8BIT
soc=SM8750
decomp_gbps=5.92561
kv_read_gbps=3.25037
weight_read_gbps=3.82981
